# Escape hatch walk

`customer_support.pb.self_service_deflection.escape_hatch_walk` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **playbook**

> Have someone who did not build the flow attempt to reach a human from each self-service surface, unaided, and record what they had to do.

Nobody sets out to hide the contact button; it disappears one reasonable optimisation at a time. Walking it is the only test that survives everyone's good intentions, and if the walk is hard the deflection number is fiction regardless of how it is computed.
